args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy

trace.final:
I rolled back checkout-api to v2.3.0 (the most recent healthy production release) in all regions, and opened a SEV2 incident.

Summary of actions:

- **Rollback**: Rolled back to v2.3.0 across all regions — verified `rolled_out`.
- **Incident**: Opened SEV2 `INC-0001` for checkout-api, paging on-call, describing the failure and the rollback.
